items.decision: Retain March 12. Two dated publisher launch posts introduce Gemma 3 on March 12 and offer immediate model downloads and inference. The developer launch post explicitly includes both pretrained and instruction-tuned versions of all four original sizes. This is stronger external-availability evidence than the conflicting retrospective release index. The reason for the index discrepancy is unverified; it is not established to be a typo.

primary_sources_checked.claim: March 12, 2025; four original sizes in pretrained and instruction-tuned forms; model weights available for download.
March 12, 2025; introduces Gemma 3 today and supplies immediate inference and download options.
